description: This file defines a Leaflet control for toggling fullscreen mode, including handling native Fullscreen API support and integrating with the Leaflet map object.

classes.name: L.Control.FullScreen
classes.description: A Leaflet control for toggling fullscreen mode, with support for native Fullscreen API and pseudo-fullscreen.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Called when the control is added to the map; creates the fullscreen toggle button.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the control is removed from the map.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates the fullscreen toggle button and binds event handlers.

methods.name: toggleFullScreen
methods.description: Toggles the map between fullscreen and windowed mode.

methods.name: _toggleTitle
methods.description: Updates the button title based on fullscreen state.

methods.name: _handleFullscreenChange
methods.description: Handles changes in fullscreen state and updates the map accordingly.
